items.title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade risks breaking up to 15,000 automated apps
items.summary: In addition to that broader estimate, independent audits have uncovered hundreds of separate compatibility problems, with core developers set to reconsider the changes Thursday.

items.title: Fed Governor Michael Barr warns AI agents could trigger bank runs in minutes
items.summary: In a speech at an AI event in Italy, Barr said automated financial decisions could overwhelm banks and raises concerns about AI systems bypassing security controls.

items.title: Bitcoin could slide into the $50,000s as Fed rate hike bets build, Wintermute says
items.summary: Bitcoin may slide into the $50,000s after losing its 200-week average, with ETF outflows, weak demand and rate-hike risks weighing on BTC, leading market maker warns.

items.title: Bitcoin drops 2.5% as Nvidia stock risks new 5-month lows into Q3 earnings
items.summary: Bitcoin price downside sees local lows of $63,269 as Nvidia stock targets $150 as traders brace for volatility over Q3 earnings.

items.title: US senators seek SEC answers on tokenized stock money laundering risks
items.summary: Four Democratic senators asked who would be responsible for tokenized shares transferred outside regulated platforms and whether the SEC could freeze or recover those tokens.

items.title: Bitcoin risks falling below $60,000 as Nvidia earnings threaten to deepen crypto selloff
items.summary: Rising bond yields, ETF outflows and forced selling are weighing on bitcoin as traders brace for more losses.

items.title: Coinbase and Broadridge propose standard for tokenized stock disclosures
items.summary: The proposed standard aims to connect tokenized stockholders with corporate disclosures and voting materials across digital wallets, but would not create shareholder rights.

items.title: Banks are banning AI agents over security... and competition concerns
items.summary: AI agents are set to automate everyday banking tasks — but banks aren’t ready to give up control of the customer relationship just yet.

items.title: Hong Kong, Swift test tokenized deposits as banks chase stablecoin-style speed
items.summary: Hong Kong and Swift expanded their efforts to connect tokenized bank deposits across currencies, building on earlier work involving digital central bank money.

items.title: Decentralized exchange Grvt looks to makes commodity trading more predictable with stable funding perps
items.summary: Grvt’s new Stable Funding Perps tie the cost of holding commodities trades to traditional-market financing costs, rather than volatile crypto-style funding.

items.title: Crypto's 'casino-chips' are disappearing, adding to pain from spot ETF outflows
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 17, 2026

items.title: Ex-OpenAI researcher fund dumps bitcoin miners, cuts IREN 94% after portfolio slump
items.summary: The fund swapped its common stock in Bloom Energy, Nebius and SanDisk for call options, keeping its bet on AI power, computing and memory.

items.title: Bitcoin remains penned in near $64,000 even as ETF outflow streak ends
items.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is down a further 1.0% since midnight UTC at around $64,200, with its bounce from the weekend selloff stalled and pressure building on all fronts.

items.title: Solana Foundation takes majority stake in crypto data provider CoinGecko
items.summary: The foundation plans Solana-powered trading on CoinGecko's website, GeckoTerminal and app.

items.title: New DeFi-yield generation targets ‘scam-like’ bank accounts that keep all the interest
items.summary: Crypto native firms like Animoca Brands are betting AI-based agentic commerce to style every area of finance with the so-called “DeFi mullet”

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin and stocks continue slump, but Nvidia boosted as Huang signals possible return
items.summary: The Fed's hawkish rhetoric continued on Tuesday, with St. Louis Fed President Musalem arguing for several rate hikes before next spring. Homebuilder confidence fell to a 14-year low.

items.title: Hackers plant crypto-stealing code on 178 major websites, including HSBC and Ledger
items.summary: An Optimizely signup flaw let an attacker plant address-swapping code on websites including HSBC, the BBC and Ledger. The total stolen remains unknown, and investigators have not linked the attack to AI.

items.title: Nvidia faces first earnings test without Jensen Huang as AI stocks slide
items.summary: With shares almost 40% below their October peak, Nvidia’s guidance could carry more weight than quarterly results as investors assess its direction without Jensen Huang.

items.title: Binance hacker moves $63 million in stolen ether after 2 weeks of silence
items.summary: North Korea's TraderTraitor group transferred 34,279 ETH to three new wallets. The funds have not moved again, blockchain investigators say.

items.title: Cardano Foundation seeks $5 million from treasury using ADA price 33% above market
items.summary: The Foundation wants 25 million ADA for 12 global events, even as the token trades well below the 20 cent price used to size the request.
